title: Symfony Reprise 1.3.0 released
content:
<html><head></head><body>Reprise 1.3.0 is out, with modulepreload under a strict CSP, a Stimulus dev loop
without restarts, and safer writes of the metadata files. This is also the first
release post since Reprise 1.0, so it covers three earlier changes that only
got a changelog…</body></html>
author: Hugo Alliaume
